portfolioDetails.title: Mooring and Anchoring systems for Floating Offshore Wind
portfolioDetails.description: In partnership with First Marine Solutions, we delivered a study for the Offshore Renewable Energy Catapult (OREC) Floating Offshore Wind Centre of Excellence (FOW CoE). The work involved assessing and developing the requirements for floating offshore wind anchoring and mooring in UK waters.
